Blinky 1.5.14

  • Token 消耗改在用量卡片旁边的窗口里看。 时间范围、Agent 和模型列表、Token 活动以及某个模型的明细都在这扇窗口里，设置里的「Token 消耗」只保留「读取本机用量记录」和用量报告的「打开」，新安装从今天开始统计。#75
  • 分享复制的是窗口上正在显示的内容。 分享会把可见的合计和列表做成图片放到剪贴板，确认显示在窗口上方，列表留在原处。#75
  • 只有开启「读取本机用量记录」时，标题栏才显示 Token 消耗按钮。 关闭这项读取后，用量卡片标题栏上的图表按钮不会出现，Blinky 启动后的第一次点击也会打开这扇窗口。#75
  • 主窗口会打开到其他应用前面。 用量卡片上的四格图标、Dock，以及从启动台或 Spotlight 启动，都会把主窗口放到最前面。#75

在 GitHub 查看更新说明

Blinky 1.5.14

  • Token spend opens beside the usage card. The time range, the agent and model lists, Token activity, and a model's details are in that window, Settings → Token spend keeps Read local usage records and the Usage recaps Open button, and a new install starts on Today. #75
  • Share copies what the window is showing. Share places an image of the visible total and lists on the clipboard, and the confirmation appears over the window so the lists stay where they are. #75
  • The Token spend button appears only while reading is on. The chart button in the usage card's header is absent while Read local usage records is off, and the first click after Blinky launches opens the window. #75
  • The main window opens in front. The grid icon on the usage card, the Dock, and a launch from Launchpad or Spotlight bring the main window in front of other apps. #75
